in_marathi.name: Arush
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arush is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arudh’ meaning 'to rise' and ‘sh’ meaning 'king'. This name is bestowed upon a child who is destined to rise and rule, just like the sun.
